qe: Which specific mode of electromagnetic wave propagation is standardly deployed to transmit an unmodulated high-frequency signal spanning up to 60 MHz across long atmospheric distances?
qh: 60 MHz तक की उच्च आवृत्ति वाले तरंगों को वायुमंडल में लंबी दूरी तक प्रसारित करने के लिए किस विशिष्ट विधि (mode of propagation) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Ground wave propagation routing near the topsoil
Sky wave propagation leveraging ionospheric bounce
Space wave propagation / Line-of-sight communication (अंतरिक्ष तरंग संचरण / स्पेस वेव)
Zwitterionic guided surface layer paths
e: Explanation: Electromagnetic waves with frequencies exceeding $40\text{ MHz}$ easily penetrate the Earth's ionosphere without undergoing total internal reflection. Consequently, they cannot be propagated via sky waves or ground waves, requiring space wave propagation (Line-of-Sight or satellite communication) instead.

qe: What core physical criterion defines the minimum height restriction ($l$) of a structural antenna tower relative to the wavelength ($\lambda$) of the electromagnetic wave it is designed to transmit?
qh: एक संरचनात्मक एंटीना टावर की न्यूनतम ऊंचाई ($l$) प्रसारित की जाने वाली तरंग के तरंगदैर्ध्य ($\lambda$) से किस प्रकार संबंधित होती है?
o: The length must scale symmetrically with the absolute radius of the planet
The architectural height must be at least one-fourth of the target wave's wavelength ($l \ge \frac{\lambda}{4}$) (तरंगदैर्ध्य का कम से कम एक चौथाई होना)
The tower must be completely insulated via unbranched synthetic polyamides
The dimension drops down to zero baseline parameters under low pressure
e: Explanation: For efficient radiation and transmission of electromagnetic signals, the physical length or height ($l$) of the antenna must be comparable to the wavelength of the signal, standardly requiring a minimum dimensional profile of $l \ge \frac{\lambda}{4}$.

qe: When an arbitrary message signal is systematically superimposed onto a high-frequency carrier wave via traditional Amplitude Modulation (AM), what operational parameter characteristically remains identical to that of the carrier wave?
qh: एम्प्लीट्यूड मॉड्यूलेशन (AM) के दौरान, वाहक तरंग (carrier wave) का कौन सा परिचालन पैरामीटर परिवर्तित नहीं होता और मूल तरंग के समान बना रहता है?
o: The absolute modulation index profile running across boundaries
The constant baseline angular frequency of the resulting modulated wave (मॉड्यूलेटेड तरंग की कोणीय आवृत्ति)
The time-varying peak voltage envelope geometry
The step-growth condensation velocity index across zones
e: Explanation: In classic amplitude modulation, the instantaneous amplitude of the high-frequency carrier wave is varied in accordance with the voltage updates of the message signal, while the carrier's original frequency ($w_c$) remains strictly unchanged.

qe: Which specific technical device architecture is utilized in communications to combine message signals with carriers, operating fundamentally under a non-linear square-law characteristic curve?
qh: संदेश सिग्नलों (message signals) को वाहक तरंगों के साथ मिलाने के लिए किस विशिष्ट तकनीकी उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है, जो स्क्वायर-लॉ (square-law) वक्र पर कार्य करता है?
o: A linear unbranched resistive alignment wire
A non-linear square-law device such as a specialized diode configuration (स्क्वायर-लॉ उपकरण / डायोड कॉन्फ़िगरेशन)
An inert macromolecular polymer filtration block
A single zwitterionic coordinate solution layer frame
e: Explanation: Producing an amplitude-modulated wave requires a non-linear mathematical operation. Devices that exhibit a non-linear current-voltage relationship (where output voltage or current tracks the square of the input, like a diode mixer) are utilized as square-law devices for modulation.

qe: If a transmitted male voice arrives at a receiving station sounding artificially elevated in pitch, closely resembling a female voice, what technical flaw likely occurred within the electronic hardware configuration?
qh: यदि प्रसारित की गई पुरुष की आवाज प्राप्तकर्ता स्टेशन पर कृत्रिम रूप से उच्च पिच (महिला की आवाज जैसी) में सुनाई देती है, तो सर्किट में कौन सी तकनीकी खराबी हुई है?
o: Complete exhaustion of the total energy supply across channels
Poor bandwidth selection or alignment parameters within the receiving amplifier circuits (एम्प्लीफायर सर्किट में खराब बैंडविड्थ चयन)
A structural conversion of the antenna lines into volatile open-chain amides
Spontaneous free-radical polymerization loops along the collection wells
e: Explanation: Bandwidth in amplitude modulation scales as twice the modulating signal frequency ($2 \cdot w_m$). If the amplifier circuits suffer from poor bandwidth selection or filtering anomalies, higher frequency bands are skewed or shifted, artificially altering the decoded pitch profile.

qe: What correct sequence maps the path and sequential elements that compose a standard, basic telecommunication network infrastructure?
qh: एक मानक और बुनियादी दूरसंचार नेटवर्क (basic telecommunication network) के तत्वों का सही क्रम कौन सा है?
o: Transmitter $\rightarrow$ user of information $\rightarrow$ receiver $\rightarrow$ channel $\rightarrow$ source

Information source $\rightarrow$ transmitter $\rightarrow$ transmission channel $\rightarrow$ receiver $\rightarrow$ user of information (सूचना स्रोत \rightarrow प्रेषित \rightarrow ट्रांसमिशन चैनल \rightarrow रिसीवर \rightarrow उपयोगकर्ता)
Transmission channel $\rightarrow$ receiver $\rightarrow$ source $\rightarrow$ transmitter $\rightarrow$ user data
User of information $\rightarrow$ channel block $\rightarrow$ source array $\rightarrow$ receptor line
e: Explanation: A functional communication system flows through five sequential components: Information Source $\rightarrow$ Transmitter (converts message to signal) $\rightarrow$ Channel (transmission medium) $\rightarrow$ Receiver (recovers message) $\rightarrow$ User of Information.

qe: What precise mathematical modulation equation describes the complete structural envelope of an amplitude-modulated (AM) wave carrying an input phase constant?
qh: इनपुट फेज स्थिरांक (phase constant) वाले एम्प्लीट्यूड-मॉड्यूलेटेड (AM) तरंग की संरचना का सही गणितीय व्यंजक क्या है?
o: $C_m(t) = A_c \cdot \sin[\{w_c + k_1 V_m(t)\}t + \phi]$
$C_m(t) = \{A_c + k_2 V_m(t)\} \cdot \sin(w_c t + \phi)$ (AM तरंग समीकरण)
$C_m(t) = A_c \cdot V_m(t) \cdot \sin(w_c t + \phi)$
$C_m(t) = A_c \cdot \sin\{w_c t + \phi + k_2 V_m(t)\}$
e: Explanation: An amplitude-modulated wave alters the original carrier amplitude ($A_c$) by a factor proportional to the modulating signal voltage ($k_2 V_m(t)$). Incorporating an arbitrary shifting phase angle ($\phi$) results in the mathematical expression: $C_m(t) = \{A_c + k_2 V_m(t)\} \cdot \sin(w_c t + \phi)$.

qe: Why can an unmodulated low-frequency baseband audio signal (such as a 15 kHz tone) not be effectively transmitted across vast geographic distances over a bare antenna wire?
qh: एक गैर-मॉड्यूलेटेड कम-आवृत्ति वाले ऑडियो सिग्नल (जैसे 15 kHz) को एक एंटीना तार के माध्यम से लंबी दूरी तक प्रभावी ढंग से क्यों नहीं प्रसारित किया जा सकता है?
o: The physical height profile required for a resonant antenna tower would be inconveniently massive, and radiation power is severely attenuated at low frequencies (एंटीना का अत्यधिक बड़ा आकार और कम विकिरण शक्ति होना)
Low frequency signals undergo instantaneous conversion into volatile gases inside channels
The waves automatically induce the cross-linking of local topsoil into rigid resins
The signal deletes all ionizable phosphate group lines across passing spaces
e: Explanation: Low-frequency signals require excessively large resonant antennas ($l = \frac{\lambda}{4}$), making physical construction impractical. Furthermore, the effective power radiated by an antenna scales inversely with the square of the wavelength ($P \propto \frac{1}{\lambda^2}$), rendering direct low-frequency transmission highly inefficient.

qe: Why is the modulation index ($m$) of a standard amplitude-modulated (AM) wave meticulously restricted to a maximum value less than or equal to one under operational limits?
qh: एक मानक एम्प्लीट्यूड-मॉड्यूलेटेड (AM) तरंग का मॉड्यूलेशन इंडेक्स ($m$) आमतौर पर एक (1) से कम या उसके बराबर क्यों रखा जाता है?
o: Exceeding one triggers an automated phase inversion that switches the device off

Exceeding one ($m > 1$) forces over-modulation, causing envelope distortion and severe clipping that results in a catastrophic loss of decoded data (ओवर-मॉड्यूलेशन के कारण विरूपण और डेटा की हानि होना)
Values greater than one generate an unbranched non-ionic surfactant lattice around the tower
The ratio alters the localized dielectric constant of air down to absolute zero
e: Explanation: The modulation index is defined as $m = \frac{A_m}{A_c}$. If $m > 1$, the amplitude of the modulating signal exceeds that of the carrier ($A_m > A_c$). This drives the system into over-modulation, where the signal envelope drops below zero, causing phase reversals and severe distortion that destroys the message data.

qe: Which specific technical compound provides the density-gradient matrix medium utilized by Meselson and Stahl to separate heavy, hybrid, and light DNA molecules?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट तकनीकी यौगिक घनत्व-प्रवणता मैट्रिक्स माध्यम (density-gradient matrix medium) प्रदान करता है जिसका उपयोग मेसेल्सन और स्टाल द्वारा भारी, हाइब्रिड और हल्के डीएनए अणुओं को अलग करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Anhydrous calcium chloride fuming syrup
Cesium Chloride / $\text{CsCl}$ (सीजियम क्लोराइड / CsCl)
Ethidium bromide fluorescent alignment liquid
Methylene cross-linked polyolefin solution gel
e: Explanation: Meselson and Stahl used cesium chloride ($ ext{CsCl}$) density-gradient centrifugation. Spinning $ ext{CsCl}$ at high speeds sets up a continuous density gradient, allowing DNA molecules to float and band at the position matching their buoyant density.

qe: What structural nomenclature describes signals whose electrical waveforms display continuous, smooth variations in amplitude over time, like the sound from a vibrating sitar string?
qh: उन सिग्नलों को क्या कहा जाता है जिनके विद्युत तरंगरूप समय के साथ एम्पलीट्यूड में निरंतर, सुचारू परिवर्तन (smooth variations) प्रदर्शित करते हैं, जैसे सितार के तार की ध्वनि?
o: Binary digital arrays
Analog Signals (एनालॉग सिग्नल / Analog)
Unbranched carbohydrate line strings
Thermosetting cross-linked network systems
e: Explanation: Analog signals are continuous waveforms whose physical or electrical parameters (such as voltage or current amplitude) vary smoothly and uninterruptedly over time to represent information.

qe: Which operational parameter describes a digital signal, separating its layout configuration fully from an analog wave format?
qh: एक डिजिटल सिग्नल (digital signal) को कौन सा परिचालन पैरामीटर एनालॉग तरंग प्रारूप से पूरी तरह अलग करता है?
o: It displays a smooth, infinite progression of uncharged energy steps
It contains discrete, quantized values represented standardly in a binary code formatting of zeroes and ones (शून्य और एक के द्विआधारी कोड में असतत मान होना)
It links consecutive atoms together using linear unbranched caprolactam lines
It dissolves completely when exposed to standard room temperature shifts
e: Explanation: Digital signals do not vary continuously. Instead, they operate with discrete, quantized levels that represent information via binary processing steps—standardly toggling between two states: high ($1$) and low ($0$).

qe: Why do high-frequency electromagnetic waves (such as a 60 MHz TV signal) fail to travel along long distances via the sky wave propagation mode?
qh: उच्च आवृत्ति वाली विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें (जैसे 60 MHz का टीवी सिग्नल) स्काई वेव संचरण (sky wave propagation) के माध्यम से लंबी दूरी तय करने में क्यों विफल रहती हैं?
o: The waves undergo rapid homolytic chain termination under atmospheric vacuum

Their high frequency permits them to penetrate straight through the ionosphere's charged layer without undergoing total internal reflection back to Earth (आयनमंडल को पार कर जाना, आंतरिक परावर्तन न होना)
The signals lack ionizable phosphate backbones to anchor along clouds
The transmission loops convert adjacent air molecules into solid non-polar resins
e: Explanation: Sky wave propagation relies on the ionosphere to reflect radio waves back to Earth via total internal reflection. However, the ionosphere can only reflect waves below a critical frequency (typically $< 30-40\text{ MHz}$). Waves with frequencies like $60\text{ MHz}$ pass straight through the ionized layers into space.

qe: If two distinct radio signals $A$ and $B$ with frequencies of 2 MHz and 3 MHz respectively are broadcast into the sky wave layer, which wave will travel a longer path inside the ionosphere before experiencing total internal reflection?
qh: यदि क्रमशः 2 MHz और 3 MHz की आवृत्तियों वाले दो रेडियो सिग्नल $A$ और $B$ को आयनमंडल में भेजा जाता है, तो कौन सी तरंग पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन से पहले अधिक दूरी तय करेगी?
o: Wave $A$ because lower frequencies require higher localized densities to bend

Wave $B$, because its higher frequency exhibits a higher effective refractive index, causing less immediate bending and allowing deeper penetration into the ionosphere before reflecting (उच्च आवृत्ति के कारण आयनमंडल में अधिक गहराई तक प्रवेश करना)
Both will drop to absolute zero velocity vectors simultaneously inside the cloud
Neither wave can bend because the ionospheric boundaries are completely cross-linked
e: Explanation: The effective refractive index of an ionized layer decreases as the frequency of the invading wave increases. Therefore, a higher-frequency signal (3 MHz) undergoes less immediate bending (refraction) than a lower-frequency signal (2 MHz), allowing it to penetrate deeper and travel farther through the ionosphere before reflecting back to Earth.

qe: Why does an Amplitude Modulated (AM) radio transmission signal characteristically suffer from significantly higher environmental noise interference compared to a Frequency Modulated (FM) signal?
qh: एक एम्प्लीट्यूड मॉड्यूलेटेड (AM) रेडियो सिग्नल में फ्रीक्वेंसी मॉड्यूलेटेड (FM) सिग्नल की तुलना में पर्यावरणीय शोर (environmental noise) का प्रभाव बहुत अधिक क्यों होता है?
o: Because AM towers convert passing signals into volatile open-chain non-polar gases

Natural and industrial noise primarily perturbs the amplitude envelope of a traveling wave, which an AM receiver decodes directly as part of the audio message (शोर द्वारा एम्प्लीट्यूड को प्रभावित करना जिसे AM सीधे डिकोड करता है)
Because AM transmission networks lack any ionizable sugar-phosphate backbone lines
Because FM signals rely on an automated system that lowers internal noise temperatures to absolute zero
e: Explanation: Most atmospheric, static, and electrical noise alters the amplitude of a propagating electromagnetic wave. Because an AM receiver decodes information by tracking amplitude variations, it inadvertently processes this noise as part of the audio signal. An FM receiver tracks frequency shifts instead, making it highly resistant to amplitude noise.

qe: To completely link the entire three-dimensional global surface of Earth using Line-of-Sight (LOS) space wave transmission towers, what is the absolute minimum count of satellite or antenna nodes required?
qh: लाइन-ऑफ-साइट (LOS) स्पेस वेव ट्रांसमिशन टावरों का उपयोग करके पृथ्वी की पूरी सतह को जोड़ने के लिए आवश्यक सैटेलाइट या एंटीना नोड्स की पूर्ण न्यूनतम संख्या क्या है?
o: Exactly two communication nodes placed at polar caps
A minimum configuration of three symmetrically placed geostationary satellite nodes (तीन भू-स्थिर उपग्रह नोड्स की न्यूनतम आवश्यकता)
Six infinite linear array blocks that ignore planetary curves
Twenty-four cross-linked coordination stations structuring a grid
e: Explanation: Due to the spherical curvature of the Earth, a single Line-of-Sight (LOS) tower can only cover a limited horizon. To achieve complete global communication coverage without blind zones, a minimum of three geostationary satellites positioned symmetrically at $120^\circ$ intervals around the equator is required.

qe: Which specific organic compound name details the molecular structure of the primary bark extract derivative used historically to treat active malaria?
qh: सक्रिय मलेरिया के इलाज के लिए ऐतिहासिक रूप से उपयोग किए जाने वाले प्राथमिक छाल अर्क व्युत्पन्न (bark extract derivative) की आणविक संरचना का विवरण देने वाला विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक कौन सा है?
o: Benzoyl variant solution
Quinine / Chloroquine derivatives (कुनैन / क्लोरोक्विन)
Novolac structural liquid paint
Caprolactam cyclic monomer fraction
e: Explanation: Quinine, an alkaloid extracted from the bark of the cinchona tree, has long been used as an antimalarial drug. Modern therapies rely on synthetic derivatives like chloroquine or artemisinin-based combination treatments to target the parasite.

qe: What structural nomenclature describes a stable chemical arrangement where a single central transition metal ion is coordinated to surrounding ligand molecules via coordinate covalent bonds?
qh: उस स्थिर रासायनिक व्यवस्था को क्या कहा जाता है जहां एक केंद्रीय संक्रमण धातु आयन उपसहसंयोजक बंधों (coordinate covalent bonds) के माध्यम से आसपास के लिगैंड अणुओं से जुड़ा होता है?
o: Amorphous Novolac resin fractions
Coordination Compound / Complex (उपसहसंयोजक यौगिक / कॉम्प्लेक्स)
Linear tactical unbranched polyolefin lines
Zwitterionic single base pair configurations
e: Explanation: A coordination compound consists of a central metal atom or ion (typically a transition element) bonded via coordinate covalent links to a surrounding array of electron-donating molecules or ions termed ligands.

qe: What happens to the structure of the cyclic monomer caprolactam when it is heated with water to generate Nylon-6?
qh: जब चक्रीय मोनोमर कैप्रोलैक्टम को नायलॉन-6 उत्पन्न करने के लिए पानी के साथ गर्म किया जाता है तो उसकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: It cross-links into a three-dimensional thermosetting network containing methylene bridges
It undergoes hydrolytic ring-opening cleavage to yield an open amino acid chain that polymerizes into a polyamide (रिंग-ओपनिंग जलअपघटन)
It undergoes oxidation into a dibasic dicarboxylic acid fragment
It forms insoluble precipitates via the common-ion effect
e: Explanation: Heating caprolactam with water at elevated temperatures breaks its internal cyclic amide bond. This ring-opening hydrolytic step yields $\varepsilon$-aminocaproic acid, which polymerizes into the linear polyamide chain of Nylon-6.

qe: What specific operational role does benzoyl peroxide assume when added to an alkene mixture during free-radical addition polymerization?
qh: मुक्त-कण जोड़ पॉलीमराइजेशन के दौरान एल्कीन मिश्रण में मिलाए जाने पर बेंज़ोयल पेरोक्साइड क्या विशिष्ट परिचालन भूमिका निभाता है?
o: It acts as a mechanical filler to increase the total density of the plastic block
It serves as a reaction initiator by undergoing homolytic cleavage to generate active free radicals (मुक्त मूलक आरंभक)
It functions as a chemical chemical inhibitor that immediately stops chain propagation
It clarifies the basification parameters of the solution via acid-base buffer mechanisms
e: Explanation: Benzoyl peroxide is thermally unstable and easily undergoes homolytic cleavage at its oxygen-oxygen single bond ($-O-O-$). This dissociation generates active phenyl free radicals that attack alkene monomers to initiate free-radical chain-growth polymerization.

qe: What precise multi-subunit structure forms the functional core of the cellular factory responsible for polymerizing amino acids into proteins?
qh: अमीनो अम्लों को प्रोटीन में जोड़ने के लिए जिम्मेदार सेलुलर फैक्ट्री (cellular factory) का मुख्य कार्यात्मक कोर कौन सी संरचना बनाती है?
o: The single-stranded linear heterogeneous hnRNA strand
The ribosome, composed of structural rRNAs and numerous proteins (राइबोसोम संरचना)
The cross-linked urea-formaldehyde resin matrix sheet
The double-stranded circular plasmid vector chromosome
e: Explanation: The ribosome is the cellular machinery responsible for protein translation. It is a ribonucleoprotein complex composed of two subunits containing structural ribosomal RNAs (rRNAs) and over 80 distinct protein molecules.

qe: Which specific organic functional group is generated when the carboxyl group of one amino acid condenses with the amino group of an adjacent unit to build a protein?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक कार्यात्मक समूह तब उत्पन्न होता है जब एक अमीनो एसिड का कार्बोक्सिल समूह प्रोटीन बनाने के लिए आसन्न इकाई के अमीनो समूह के साथ संघनित होता है?
o: Glycosidic connection bridging rings together
Peptide linkage / Amide bond (पेप्टाइड बंध / एमाइड लिंक)
Phosphodiester coordinate bridge balancing frames
Sulfur disulfide cross-link system anchoring paths
e: Explanation: Combining the alpha-carboxyl group of one amino acid with the alpha-amino center of another eliminates a water molecule, establishing a covalent amide linkage ($-CONH-$) termed a peptide bond or peptide linkage.

qe: What happens to the structure of linear Novolac strands if they are mixed with excess formaldehyde gas and subjected to high thermal curing?
qh: यदि रैखिक नोवोलेक स्ट्रैंड्स को अतिरिक्त फॉर्मलाडेहाइड गैस के साथ मिला जाए और उच्च थर्मल क्यूरिंग के अधीन किया जाए तो उनकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: They break down into volatile liquid phenols via hydrolytic cleavage
They develop extensive covalent methylene cross-links, transforming the linear resin into the rigid thermosetting network Bakelite (क्रॉस-लिंक्ड बैकेलाइट नेटवर्क)
They convert into an unbranched biodegradable polyester chain configuration
They form an explicit water-soluble uncharged non-ionic surfactant lattice balanced by sodium
e: Explanation: Novolac is a linear condensation intermediate. Heating Novolac with excess formaldehyde introduces methylene linkages that cross-link the chains into a permanent three-dimensional network, creating the infusible thermosetting polymer Bakelite.

qe: Which structural feature characterises the alpha-helix secondary structure of a protein, keeping the right-handed screw shape stable?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक प्रोटीन की alphas-हेलिक्स माध्यमिक संरचना की विशेषता है, जो दाहिने हाथ की पेंच जैसी आकृति को स्थिर रखती है?
o: Weak van der Waals forces acting uniformly across non-polar branches
Intramolecular hydrogen bonds formed between the N-H group of an amino acid residue and the carbonyl C=O group of an adjacent turn (N-H और C=O के बीच हाइड्रोजन बंध)
Reversible ester links that undergo rapid reduction with basic catalysts
Cationic quaternary nitrogen halide cross-linked coordination zones
e: Explanation: The helical conformation of an $\alpha$-helix is locked and stabilized by a dense network of regular hydrogen bonds. These form between the polar amide $N-H$ groups situated along one loop of the coiling backbone and the carbonyl $C=O$ functional groups of the adjacent turn.

qe: What precise sequence of structural parts represents the generic composition of a single nucleotide building block inside nucleic acid backbones?
qh: न्यूक्लिक एसिड बैकबोन के भीतर एकल न्यूक्लियोटाइड बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक की सामान्य संरचना का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला सटीक अनुक्रम क्या है?
o: A long lipophilic carbon chain bound tightly to pure sulfur matrices
A pentose sugar molecule covalently linked to a heterocyclic base and an esterified phosphate group (शर्करा-बेस-फॉस्फेट असेंबली)
An aromatic polyol layer mixed with fuming formaldehyde syrup segments
A glycine residue bound via alternating amide and dicarboxylic bands
e: Explanation: A single nucleotide is composed of three covalently bound elements: a five-carbon pentose sugar (ribose or deoxyribose), a nitrogenous base attached to the C1' position of the sugar, and a phosphate group esterified to its C5' position.

qe: What specific underlying cellular event characterizes the onset of an autoimmune disease like rheumatoid arthritis?
qh: रुमेटॉइड आर्थराइटिस (rheumatoid arthritis) जैसे ऑटो-इम्यून रोग की शुरुआत किस विशिष्ट कोशिकीय घटना के कारण होती है?
o: The absolute deactivation of all circulating lymphocytes
The immune system loses its ability to differentiate foreign molecules from self-cells, attacking the body's own tissues (प्रतिracción तंत्र द्वारा स्वयं की कोशिकाओं पर हमला करना)
The sudden over-production of non-specific volatile amides
The complete cross-linking of structural alpha-helix channels
e: Explanation: Autoimmunity occurs when the host's immune infrastructure loses self-tolerance. It fails to distinguish foreign pathogens from self-molecules, causing circulating lymphocytes to actively attack and destroy the body's own tissues, as seen in rheumatoid arthritis.

qe: Which specific viral infectious pathology is recognized under medical standards as the most fatal communicable disease currently monitored across global human populations?
qh: चिकित्सा मानकों के अनुसार किस विशिष्ट वायरल संक्रामक विकृति को वर्तमान में मानव आबादी में सबसे घातक संक्रामक रोग (most fatal communicable disease) के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त है?
o: The classic non-mutated Scurvy variant
AIDS caused by Human Immunodeficiency Virus infection (एड्स / AIDS)
The linear unbranched Novolac resin footprint
Monomeric caprolactam structural deficiency clones
e: Explanation: Infectious diseases can be transmitted from person to person. Among monitored viral communicable diseases, Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS), caused by HIV, is classified as the most critical and fatal due to its systematic destruction of the host's immune infrastructure.

qe: What unique physical structural characteristic of the DNA double helix is maintained by the specific pairing of purines with pyrimidines?
qh: डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स की कौन सी भौतिक संरचनात्मक विशेषता प्यूरीन और पिरिमिडीन के विशिष्ट युग्मन (pairing) द्वारा बनाए रखी जाती है?
o: The antiparallel nature of the two strands
Uniform width throughout the DNA helix (डीएनए की एकसमान चौड़ाई)
The semi-conservative mode of replication
Uniform length across all distinct DNA types
e: Explanation: Pairing a bulky purine with a smaller pyrimidine ensures that the distance between the two strands remains constant (approx. 20 Å), resulting in a uniform width across the entire length of the DNA helix.

qe: How do the net electric charges of DNA and histones differ when they associate to form nucleosomes?
qh: जब न्यूक्लियोसोम बनाने के लिए डीएनए और हिस्टोन जुड़ते हैं, तो उनके शुद्ध विद्युत आवेश (net electric charges) कैसे भिन्न होते हैं?
o: Both carry a net positive charge
Both carry a net negative charge
DNA is negative, and Histones are positive (डीएनए ऋणात्मक एवं हिस्टोन धनात्मक)
Both carry zero net charge
e: Explanation: DNA is negatively charged due to its phosphate backbone. Histones are rich in basic amino acids like lysine and arginine, which carry a net positive charge at physiological pH, allowing for tight electrostatic association.

qe: In the transcription unit, where are the promoter and terminator sites located relative to the coding strand?
qh: ट्रांसक्रिप्शन यूनिट में, कोडिंग धागे के सापेक्ष प्रमोटर (promoter) और टर्मिनेटर (terminator) साइटें कहाँ स्थित होती हैं?
o: Both are located at the 3' (downstream) end
Promoter is at the 5' (upstream) end, and Terminator is at the 3' (downstream) end (प्रमोटर 5' पर एवं टर्मिनेटर 3' पर)
Only the 5' end for both sites
Only the 3' end for both sites
e: Explanation: In a transcription unit, the promoter serves as the RNA polymerase binding site and is located at the 5' end (upstream) of the structural gene. The terminator defines the end of transcription and is located at the 3' end (downstream).

qe: Why is sickle-cell anaemia accurately classified as a 'molecular disease'?
qh: सिकल-सेल एनीमिया (sickle-cell anaemia) को 'आणविक रोग' (molecular disease) के रूप में सटीक रूप से क्यों वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
o: Because it can be easily treated with high-dose iron supplements
Because it is caused by a specific point mutation in the beta-globin chain gene (बीटा-ग्लोबिन जीन में बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन)
Because it grants complete immunity to malaria infections
Because it is caused by viral capsid structural folding
e: Explanation: Sickle-cell anaemia is a genetic disorder caused by a single point mutation where the amino acid glutamate is replaced by valine at the sixth position of the beta-globin chain, making it a classic molecular disease.

qe: What functional properties define the relationship of the AUG codon in protein synthesis?
qh: प्रोटीन संश्लेषण में AUG कोडन (AUG codon) के संबंध में कौन से कार्यात्मक गुण सत्य हैं?
o: It codes for methionine, and it functions as an initiation codon (मिथियोनिन के लिए कोड करना एवं दीक्षा कोडन होना)
It codes for valine only
It is an exclusively stop codon for both prokaryotes and eukaryotes
It is ignored by ribosomes during the translation phase
e: Explanation: AUG is a dual-function codon: it specifies the amino acid methionine and serves as the universal initiation signal for protein synthesis in both prokaryotes and eukaryotes.

qe: What scientific evidence suggests that RNA was the first genetic material on Earth?
qh: कौन सा वैज्ञानिक साक्ष्य यह बताता है कि पृथ्वी पर आरएनए (RNA) पहली आनुवंशिक सामग्री थी?
o: Proteins evolved from RNA, but RNA lacks stability
Essential life processes, such as metabolism and translation, evolved around RNA, which acts as a catalyst (मेटाबोलिज्म एवं ट्रांसलेशन आरएनए के चारों ओर विकसित हुए)
DNA was formed from RNA via spontaneous mineral precipitation
RNA molecules consist of triple-stranded lattice configurations
e: Explanation: Current research suggests life processes like translation and metabolism evolved around RNA. RNA acts as both genetic material and a catalyst, though its reactivity makes it less stable than DNA.

qe: In eukaryotic mRNA maturation, which sequences remain in the final transcript?
qh: यूकैरियोटिक mRNA परिपक्वता (maturation) में, कौन से अनुक्रम अंतिम प्रतिलेख में बने रहते हैं?
o: Introns only
Exons only (केवल एक्सॉन)
Both introns and exons
Neither introns nor exons
e: Explanation: Eukaryotic genes are 'split', meaning they contain non-coding introns and coding exons. During processing, introns are removed (spliced out), and only the exons appear in the mature, processed mRNA.

qe: Which human chromosome possesses the highest count of functional genes, and which one contains the fewest?
qh: मानव गुणसूत्रों में से किसमें कार्यात्मक जीनों की संख्या सबसे अधिक और किसमें सबसे कम है?
o: Chromosome 1 (highest) and Y (lowest) (गुणसूत्र 1 सर्वाधिक, गुणसूत्र Y न्यूनतम)
Chromosome 11 (highest) and X (lowest)
Chromosome 21 (highest) and 1 (lowest)
Chromosome X (highest) and Y (lowest)
e: Explanation: Human Genome Project data revealed that Chromosome 1 harbors the highest number of genes (approx. 2968), whereas the Y chromosome has the fewest (approx. 231 genes).

qe: Which scientists utilized X-ray diffraction data to propose the double-helix DNA model in 1953?
qh: 1953 में डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स मॉडल प्रस्तावित करने के लिए किस वैज्ञानिक जोड़ी ने एक्स-रे विवर्तन डेटा (X-ray diffraction data) का उपयोग किया था?
o: Rosalind Franklin and Maurice Wilkins
James Watson and Francis Crick (वाटसन एवं क्रिक)
Erwin Chargaff and Arthur Kornberg
Meselson and Stahl
e: Explanation: James Watson and Francis Crick proposed the famous double helix model in 1953, utilizing X-ray diffraction data generated by Maurice Wilkins and Rosalind Franklin.

qe: Why must the 3'-OH group be removed or replaced when synthesizing artificial DNA strands to prevent uncontrolled polymerization?
qh: कृत्रिम डीएनए धागों को संश्लेषित करते समय अनियंत्रित पॉलीमराइजेशन को रोकने के लिए 3'-OH समूह को क्यों हटाया या प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए?
o: Because purines interfere with pyrimidines at the 3' end
Because DNA polymerase requires a free 3'-OH group to add new nucleotides; blocking it stops chain extension (3'-OH की अनुपस्थिति से पॉलीमराइजेशन रुक जाता है)
Because the phosphate group naturally blocks the 3' position
Because 2'-OH groups initiate explosive cleavage
e: Explanation: DNA polymerase synthesizes DNA by adding nucleotides to the free 3'-OH group of the growing strand. If the 3'-OH group is blocked or absent, the polymerase cannot add the next nucleotide, effectively stopping the polymerization reaction.

qe: Why does the synthesis of the DNA lagging strand proceed in a discontinuous fashion (Okazaki fragments)?
qh: डीएनए लैगिंग स्ट्रैंड (lagging strand) का संश्लेषण असतत तरीके (ओकाजाकी खंड) से क्यों होता है?
o: Because DNA molecules are too long to synthesize continuously
Because DNA polymerase can only catalyze polymerization in one direction (5' to 3') (DNA पॉलीमरेज की एकदिशीय प्रकृति)
Because the process is fundamentally inefficient in bacteria
Because DNA ligase needs to exert a mechanical force on the strands
e: Explanation: DNA polymerase only catalyzes synthesis in the 5' to 3' direction. Since the two parent strands are anti-parallel, one strand (leading) is synthesized continuously, while the other (lagging) must be synthesized in short, discontinuous segments known as Okazaki fragments.

qe: Which specific enzyme is responsible for the transcription process in prokaryotes?
qh: प्रोकैरियोट्स में ट्रांसक्रिप्शन (transcription) प्रक्रिया के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट एंजाइम जिम्मेदार है?
o: DNA Ligase
DNA-dependent RNA polymerase (डीएनए-निर्भर आरएनए पॉलीमरेज)
Restriction endonuclease
Taq Polymerase
e: Explanation: In prokaryotes, a single type of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase is responsible for the transcription of all types of RNA (mRNA, tRNA, and rRNA).

qe: At what functional level does the regulation of gene expression primarily occur in eukaryotic systems?
qh: यूकैरियोटिक प्रणालियों में जीन अभिव्यक्ति (gene expression) का विनियमन प्राथमिक रूप से किस कार्यात्मक स्तर पर होता है?
o: During DNA replication
Transcriptional level, during the formation of primary transcripts (ट्रांसक्रिप्शनल स्तर पर)
During protein folding in the Golgi apparatus
None of these
e: Explanation: Gene expression in eukaryotes can be regulated at several levels, including transcriptional (primary transcript formation), processing (splicing), transport of mRNA, and translational levels.
